topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: When I discovered my essay woven into the fabric of advice for others, a warmth bloomed within me, much like the first light of dawn. My words, once private, now danced in the open, a song to those who sought their path. It was as if I had planted a seed, and from it grew a tree, its branches reaching out, offering shade and inspiration. The thought of strangers finding guidance, perhaps even comfort, in my experiences, fills me with a quiet joy. It feels right, like the sun warming the earth, urging life to spring forth.
